title: Observability Weekly - 2026-04-13
summary: Weekly notes: tracing sampler changes, cost telemetry dashboard updates, dashboard perf fixes, open action items and blockers.
notes:
Attendees: Sofia Patel (owner), Mark Li, Priya Reddy, Aaron Thompson, Elena Garcia

Standup updates:
- Sofia: pushed OTel sampler change to dev (reduce default parent-based sampling to 5% for bulk API paths). Observed 18% reduction in span volume in staging. Need load test to validate no regression in error detection.
- Mark: updated TraceQL queries for cross-service latency heatmap; added tag filtering for model-route + quantization profile. Will open PR for dashboard panel refresh.
- Priya: finished cost-telemetry ingestion pipeline prototype; ingestion lag currently ~90s due to batching window. Working on tuning to target 30s.
- Aaron: debugged missing billing labels for a subset of Dedicated requests; root cause: metadata agent drop on retry path. Patch in review.
- Elena: finished runbook draft for tracer agent OOMs and samplers; needs tech review.

Meeting notes (Observability sync 2026-04-13 10:00):
- Tracing:
  * Sampler rollout plan: canary 10% on staging -> ramp to 50% on canary cluster -> prod in two waves. Need perf+alerting for loss of error visibility.
  * KV cache spans: added early-exit span to identify cold-start cache misses; initial data shows ~7% cold-starts on warm traffic. Action: add local caching layer to serving runtime.
- Dashboards:
  * Cost telemetry dashboard: new per-route token-cost panel merged in dev-console. Found a rendering perf regression for >500 routes. Mark to optimize query and add pagination.
  * Tracing heatmap: switched to aggregated rollup index to reduce query time; p95 query time reduced from 4.2s to 1.1s in staging.
- Cost telemetry:
  * Ingestion accuracy: observed mismatch between billing export and our ingestion for 2026-04-11 (~1.6%). Investigating labeling edge cases and timezone conversion bugs.
  * Alerts: created anomaly alert (threshold and statistical baseline) for sudden cost-per-token spikes; threshold currently tuned on last 30 days baseline.
- Observability SLO/SLI review:
  * Proposed SLI: end-to-end trace coverage for sampled requests >= 85% for critical routes. Need to validate against sampler changes.
  * SLO sync scheduled with SRE next Tuesday to align on latency SLOs and error budget burn policies.

Decisions made:
- Proceed with sampler canary next week (2026-04-20) after adding additional error-visibility dashboards.
- Prioritize cost telemetry ingestion latency improvements (target 30s) and looker/dashboard pagination before general availability.

Notes to self / loose threads:
- Need to coordinate with release-engineering for config flag rollout windows for Dedicated clusters.
- Check with Console team on embedding the new cost dashboard into the tenant overview page (follow up PR).
- Add a unit in the runbook about how to toggle sampler rates and forced-sample on critical traces.
